summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no edits made) I traced the full chain the ticket asked about: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → schema → `db/auth.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I could **not** find the client-side/anonymous-fallback bug it describes: - Client never touches localStorage/sessionStorage for watchlist data — every read/write is a real API call, and `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request. - Eve
